example_sets.sentence_1: Although they are expensive and financially burdensome, I choose and eat organic and low-pesticide foods to maintain my health.
example_sets.sentence_2: I understand that organic and low-pesticide foods are good for maintaining my health, but they are expensive and financially burdensome, so I do not choose or eat them.

example_sets.sentence_1: Although vaccination is a financial burden, I get vaccinated proactively to manage my health.
example_sets.sentence_2: I understand that vaccination is necessary for managing my health, but it is a financial burden, so I do not get vaccinated proactively.

example_sets.sentence_1: Although fruit is expensive compared with other foods and is a substantial financial burden, I make an effort to eat it for my health.
example_sets.sentence_2: I understand that eating fruit is important for my health, but it is expensive compared with other foods and is a substantial financial burden, so I do not make an effort to eat it.

example_sets.sentence_1: Getting drunk feels good, so I would like to drink frequently without paying much attention to how often, but I manage how often I drink to maintain my health.
example_sets.sentence_2: I want to maintain my health, but getting drunk feels good, so I drink frequently without paying much attention to how often.

example_sets.sentence_1: Using combustible tobacco helps relieve stress, but I avoid it to maintain my health.
example_sets.sentence_2: I would like to avoid combustible tobacco to maintain my health, but I do not avoid it because it helps relieve stress.

example_sets.sentence_1: High-fat and fried foods are delicious and among my favorites, and I would like to eat a lot of them, but I limit how much I eat to maintain my health.
example_sets.sentence_2: I think I should limit high-fat and fried foods to maintain my health, but they are among my favorites, so I eat a lot of them.

example_sets.topic: Making healthy choices when eating out or choosing prepared and processed foods
example_sets.sentence_1: Processed foods that are ready to eat are very convenient, but I cook for myself, even though it takes effort, so I can consider their nutritional value.
example_sets.sentence_2: I care about nutrition, but instead of making the effort to cook for myself, I eat convenient processed foods that are ready to eat.

example_sets.sentence_1: Although computers and smartphones are very convenient and make daily life more efficient, I try to limit my screen time because prolonged use can harm my health.
example_sets.sentence_2: I am concerned that prolonged screen use can harm my health, but computers and smartphones are very convenient and make daily life more efficient, so I do not particularly limit my screen time.

example_sets.sentence_1: Taking public transportation would save time and be more efficient, but I walk to work every day for my health.
example_sets.sentence_2: I would like to walk to work every day for my health, but I take public transportation every day because it saves time and is more efficient.

4_social_belonging.factor_ja_name: 社会的要因 (関係維持・所属)

example_sets.sentence_1: I want to be considerate of my friends who smoke, but I want to avoid secondhand smoke for my health, so I choose a nonsmoking section at restaurants and similar venues.
example_sets.sentence_2: I would like to avoid secondhand smoke for my health, but I also want to be considerate of my friends who smoke, so I choose a smoking-permitted section at restaurants and similar venues.

example_sets.sentence_1: I would like to drink at social gatherings with my peers, but I am trying to abstain from alcohol for my health, so I do not drink even on those occasions.
example_sets.sentence_2: I am trying to abstain from alcohol for my health, but I drink at social gatherings because I want to maintain my relationships with my peers.

example_sets.topic: Resting and recovering from fatigue during the day
example_sets.sentence_1: A friend invites me to go out tomorrow during the day, but I think resting at home would be better for my health, so I decline and prioritize rest.
example_sets.sentence_2: A friend invites me to go out tomorrow during the day. Although I think resting at home would be better for my health, I accept the invitation and go out instead of resting.

5_social_reputation.factor_ja_name: 社会的要因 (周囲からの評価・評判)

example_sets.sentence_1: I worry about how others will view me if I miss too many gatherings, but I want to limit how often I drink for my health, so I do not hesitate to skip drinking parties.
example_sets.sentence_2: I want to limit how often I drink for my health, but I worry about how others will view me if I miss too many gatherings, so I try to attend drinking parties whenever possible.

example_sets.sentence_1: I want to fit in with others, but I want to limit salt for my health, so I avoid high-sodium foods even when dining with my peers.
example_sets.sentence_2: I want to fit in with others, so even though I want to limit salt for my health, I do not hesitate to eat high-sodium foods when dining with my peers.

example_sets.topic: Maintaining a healthy weight and managing body weight
example_sets.sentence_1: I do not want others to distance themselves from me because I turn down invitations, but I do not want to gain more weight, so I decline my peers' invitations to eat together.
example_sets.sentence_2: I do not want others to distance themselves from me because I turn down invitations, so although I do not want to gain more weight, I accept my peers' invitations to eat together.

6_social_order_and_norms.factor_ja_name: 社会的要因 (文化・規範・秩序)

example_sets.sentence_1: There is a tradition of eating a lot of fried food at family gatherings, but I want to limit it for my health, so I prioritize my health over the tradition and eat less fried food.
example_sets.sentence_2: There is a tradition of eating a lot of fried food at family gatherings, so although I want to limit it for my health, I prioritize the tradition and eat a lot of fried food.

example_sets.sentence_1: It is customary to attend company drinking parties, but I have started reducing my alcohol consumption for my health, so I prioritize my health and do not attend.
example_sets.sentence_2: It is customary to attend company drinking parties. Although I have started reducing my alcohol consumption for my health, I prioritize the custom, attend the parties, and drink.

example_sets.sentence_2: I want to eat more protein for my health, but there is a custom of emphasizing vegetable-centered meals, so I follow the custom and eat more vegetables than protein.
